$description: Snapshot of a Figma library, written by packages/tokens/scripts/figma/export.js. Don't edit by hand: refresh it from Figma. The drift tests check the token sources and figma.ts against it.

42:141.name: Link Header
42:141.description: Link page header: the wordmark, then Blog and Shop (Pill Button, Ghost) and Follow (Outlined) at the right. Mobile drops the ghost links and shrinks the wordmark to 26px. .lk-header. Copy: LINK_SAMPLE.wordmark, nav, follow.

42:241.name: Link Profile

Bio.default: Projects, experiments, products, music, and an ongoing exploration of what’s possible

42:241.description: Profile: Avatar, the name as the page h1, tags, bio (scrim 60%) and social Icon Buttons, each needing an aria-label in code. Desktop sits side by side; Mobile stacks with the Compact avatar and a 38px name. .lk-profile. Copy: LINK_SAMPLE.profile. Tags is a slot: fill it with Tag instances (Primitives), as many as the item has.

42:354.name: Tab Bar
42:354.description: Filters the Link Rows: All, Studio, Blog, Shop, Support (a role="group" of toggle buttons). Desktop: five equal cells, 8px apart. Mobile: tabs hug their labels and the row scrolls sideways (scrollbar hidden). Swap a Tab to State=Selected to show the active filter. .lk-tabs.

44:203.name: Link Row

Description.default: Projects, experiments, products, music, and an ongoing exploration of what’s possible.

44:203.description: One link: media, then kicker, title, description and tags, then the Go button. The whole row is the link (an <a> when it has an href). Desktop: media 210–280px wide, 160 tall, beside the text. Mobile: media full width, 180 tall, above the text. Media without an image shows scrim at 80%; put an image fill on Media to use one. Kicker is exposed: set its Icon (Studio Command, Blog Feather, Shop/Support Layout Grid) and Label. Hover lifts the row to surface-container-lowest and the Go button to primary. Was Workbench Link Row 118:515. .lk-row. Tags is a slot: fill it with Tag instances (Primitives), as many as the item has.

44:218.name: Link Tile
44:218.description: A short link under the rows: kicker plus a burst label, centred, at least 80px tall. Three to a row on desktop, one per row on mobile. Hover is new here; code has none yet. .lk-tile. Copy: LINK_SAMPLE.tiles.
